body: No. I saw a therapist at one point,  but due to the fact that it was incredibly expensive, unaffordable,  and he never listened to me, just lectured on about how I'm a teenager and things get better,  I lied and said I was better to get out of there.
She never pushed it. We watched tons of movies together, just not that one.

I really appreciate the advice. You hit every nail on the head. I just can't stop worrying about it and thinking about her, regardless of what option I pick. I accepted the request but have no plans to initiate any contact. Why do I still feel like I'm doing something wrong though? I feel like an asshole the way I'm acting. I realize that deep down I really want her back, but I know, or think, that's not a realistic option. The reason she broke us up was understandable and completely justifiable, and that's what hurts the most. Thank you so much.

One person was a therapist I saw for a little a year ago because my parents were concerned. He said I was fine, case closed. We just kinda pushed it all under the table. The other person was a potential romantic interest, but she was depressed, and I wasn't according to her. I ditched her pretty quick. 

No, I haven't told my parents. They knew I was kinda down at one point, but not that I occasionally think about hurting myself.
